name: custta
description: Ferramentas de teste e deploy do Custta. O APP em si continua sem build: HTML, CSS e JS servidos como arquivos estáticos. Nada aqui é empacotado no que roda no navegador.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/calc.test.cjs tests/moeda.test.cjs tests/icons.test.cjs tests/teclado.test.cjs tests/resumo.test.cjs tests/xss.test.cjs tests/headers.test.cjs tests/pwa.test.cjs tests/workflow.test.cjs tests/sync.test.cjs tests/fila.test.mjs
